    FLAG FOOTBALL SPRING 2018 IS HERE!

    ​

    February 2018

    • Hello,

    • ​

    • Are you ready from some football? Our Quad Sports 2018 Spring NFL Flag Football season begins Saturday, February 24th! Here’s some important information regarding our upcoming season:

    • Practice  & Game Times:


    • Pee Wee Division (4-7 year olds)


    • 10:30am-11:30am  (Practice)


    • 11:30am-12:30pm (Game Time)

    •  


    • Junior Division (8-10 year olds)


    • 9:30am-10:30am (Practice)

    • 10:30am-11:30am (Game Time)


    • Senior Division (11-14 year olds)


    • 8:00am-9:00am (Practice)

    • 9:00am-10:00am (Game Time)

    • ​

    • ***We ask that on the first day, that you arrive 20 minutes prior to your scheduled practice time, so that you can be assigned to your team and provided your uniform equipment. Also, please bring your signed Release Form which can be downloaded fromwww.quadsports.net under the Information and Links section.

    • ​

    • Practice takes place the hour before game time. The first 10-15 minutes of each practice consists of group stretch and drills. Please have your child on time for practice.

    • Each team will need a Team Parent. This person will serve as the contact for snack rotation lists, picture day and any assistance the coach may need from the parents. If you would like to volunteer as the Team Parent for your child’s team, please let your coach know on opening day.

    • We ask that after each game, families rotate providing snacks to their team. A simple snack is suffice (Ex. Juice box and Granola bar). Please get with the Team Parent to sign up for your turn.

    • Mouthpieces are needed for all practices and games. Please make sure your child has it with them. No child can practice or play without a mouthpiece. There will be mouthpieces available for purchase on site for $2.

    • Safety is a top priority. Please make sure your child has the appropriate equipment needed for practice and games.

    • All NFL flag football participants must complete the NFL Participant Agreement form. Your child will not be allowed to play if the form isn’t completed. Please go to nflflag.com/register. Here you will create an account and click the box “I want to associate with my league”. You will then select Quad Sports in the search field.

    • Weather updates for game day are available on our website at the top of the page every Saturday morning by 7:00 am.

    • If your child has any special needs or concerns, please let Quad Sports Administration and your team coach know.

    • Quad Sports provides:Team uniform shirts, flags/belts

    • Parents provide:Mouthpiece, personal water/gatorade, athletic shoes or football cleats, and dark color bottoms (shorts/sweatpants).

    • Football swag gear will be available for purchase at the registration table.

    •  

    • There are a few spots left for volunteers. If interested, please contact us.

    • We look forward to the start of the season and our pleased that you’ve selected Quad Sports for your child’s sports experience.

FLAG FOOTBALL SPRING 2018 IS HERE!​

February 2018

Hello,


​


Are you ready from some football? Our Quad Sports 2018 Spring NFL Flag Football season begins Saturday, February 24th! Here’s some important information regarding our upcoming season:


Practice  & Game Times:



Pee Wee Division (4-7 year olds)



10:30am-11:30am  (Practice)



11:30am-12:30pm (Game Time)


 



Junior Division (8-10 year olds)



9:30am-10:30am (Practice)


10:30am-11:30am (Game Time)



Senior Division (11-14 year olds)



8:00am-9:00am (Practice)


9:00am-10:00am (Game Time)


​


***We ask that on the first day, that you arrive 20 minutes prior to your scheduled practice time, so that you can be assigned to your team and provided your uniform equipment. Also, please bring your signed Release Form which can be downloaded fromwww.quadsports.net under the Information and Links section.


​


Practice takes place the hour before game time. The first 10-15 minutes of each practice consists of group stretch and drills. Please have your child on time for practice.


Each team will need a Team Parent. This person will serve as the contact for snack rotation lists, picture day and any assistance the coach may need from the parents. If you would like to volunteer as the Team Parent for your child’s team, please let your coach know on opening day.


We ask that after each game, families rotate providing snacks to their team. A simple snack is suffice (Ex. Juice box and Granola bar). Please get with the Team Parent to sign up for your turn.


Mouthpieces are needed for all practices and games. Please make sure your child has it with them. No child can practice or play without a mouthpiece. There will be mouthpieces available for purchase on site for $2.


Safety is a top priority. Please make sure your child has the appropriate equipment needed for practice and games.


All NFL flag football participants must complete the NFL Participant Agreement form. Your child will not be allowed to play if the form isn’t completed. Please go to nflflag.com/register. Here you will create an account and click the box “I want to associate with my league”. You will then select Quad Sports in the search field.


Weather updates for game day are available on our website at the top of the page every Saturday morning by 7:00 am.


If your child has any special needs or concerns, please let Quad Sports Administration and your team coach know.


Quad Sports provides:Team uniform shirts, flags/belts


Parents provide:Mouthpiece, personal water/gatorade, athletic shoes or football cleats, and dark color bottoms (shorts/sweatpants).


Football swag gear will be available for purchase at the registration table.


 


There are a few spots left for volunteers. If interested, please contact us.


We look forward to the start of the season and our pleased that you’ve selected Quad Sports for your child’s sports experience.
